decision.rule: A: per-draw OLS slope of the peak location on log2 epoch over E4..E32, df-9 t interval. B: INTERIOR_PEAK iff the df-9 interval of the mean epoch-averaged quadratic curvature lies below 0, the vertex of the mean quadratic lies in [log2 64, log2 384], and with a data-located break (per point, the rung nearest its quadratic vertex clamped to 96..256, in both lines) every draw has mean two-lines slopes and their df-9 intervals lie above 0 (left) and below 0 (right), and the df-9 interval of the per-point rise and fall min(left, -right), averaged per draw, lies above 0 (else RISE_AND_FALL_NOT_WITHIN_POINTS). Saturation rule S1/S32/SD for both. A result other than INTERIOR_PEAK is inconclusive for shallow peaks, not evidence that no peak exists.

note: Only the two decision labels are pre-registered primaries; every other section is secondary or descriptive.
